headline: Ganges Securities informs exchange about postal ballot notice
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: Ganges Securities Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. The company has initiated the postal ballot process for seeking shareholder approval on unspecified resolutions. Shareholders of record as on the eligibility date will be able to cast their votes electronically. Further details regarding the specific agenda items and voting timelines will be shared in the formal postal ballot notice.
whats_next: Voting results of the postal ballot
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no immediate financial impact.
